label: Approvals fixed by natures is the alternative to nature-fixed approval variation
note: Incompatible: fixed approvals give the same approvals in every nature-fixed profile, which the variation premise denies (the divine joint model has fixed approvals and no variation). Target: the variation premise of the Euthyphro core. Mechanism: the assessor's approval follows from the natures, as on an intellectualist or divine-nature account of approval. Independent justification: for a divine assessor, divine simplicity and the dependence of will on intellect (unread leads, ST I q.19); for a human assessor no positive justification is on file, and actual variation of human approvals with natures held fixed is the ordinary case. It is derived for a command theory that keeps invariance (dctGroundPrice).
